text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
36;.
dated September 3, 1947, is hereby further amended
to read as follows:
Now, therefore, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the. Philippines,
by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby create
body to be known as the. National Advisory Health Council- to
study problems of public health and sanitation and to make such
recommendations as it may deem necessary for the improvement
of public health and sanitation and the promotion of medical research.
The Council shall be composed of the following:
The Secretary of Health
The Undersecretary of Health
'The Director of Health ..
The Director of Quarantine
The Director of Public Schools
The Dean, College of Medicine, UP
The Dean, College of Medicine, UST
The Dean, College of Medicine, MCU
The Chairman, Board of Medical Examiners
The Chairman, Board of Dental Examiners
The President, Philippine Medical. Association
The President, Philippine Public Health Association
Vice-Chairman
The President, Philippine Federation of Private Medical
Practitioners:
The President, Philippine Pharmaceutical Association:
The President, League of District and City Health
The President, Filipino Nurses Association
The members of the Council shall serve without compensation
and. their term shali be co-terminous with their tenure in their
regular positions."
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of March,
in the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one,
and of the Independence of. the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1065:
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
